body:
We need to verify we have fully tested ACID readiness of the system

We should make sure we have different concurrency and version control strategies implement, so these are also configurable.

We should also add replaceable decorator layers for different distributed storage synchronization strategies.

So we check source code of all successful data storage systems (DBMS) and implement different kinds of distributed control, transactional control, with different configurations and settings.

So our system is pure database engines constructor based on decorators with same API, where we can swap different decorators and get different configurations for user to explore. Each decorator must add costs only for specific guarantees.

We must fully implement it in all supported languages, and double check we have 100% tests coverage and edge cases, guarantees tests with unit testing + integration tests and so on.

So for each scenario we have docs on how to use our system.

For example in some cases we should be able to use our system efficiently as just data cache, in some cases we should be able to use it as reliable transactional data store, and for some users it may be imported to create a cluster that is scalable preferably horizontally, with or without sharing and so on.

Explore all best possible ideas and strategies by competitors, and make sure we implement it all.

Our docs also should contain all the comparison with specific competitors and how we can configure the same in our system.

Be ambitious with our requirements.

We need to collect data related about the issue to this repository, make sure we compile that data to `./docs/case-studies/issue-{id}` folder, and use it to do deep case study analysis (also make sure to search online for additional facts and data), list of each and all requirements from the issue, and propose possible solutions and solution plans for each requirement (we should also check known existing components/libraries, that solve similar problem or can help in solutions).

Please plan and execute everything in this single pull request, you have unlimited time and context, as context auto-compacts and you can continue indefinitely, until each and every requirement fully addressed, and everything is totally done.
title: ACID readiness and transaction and concurrency control strategies
